name: Hunter (fast sniper ship)
description: A fast, fragile Procyon sniper ship with its own long needle hull, pontoons and side sails, and a beam gun built into its bow that charges, then holds a beam that burns harder the longer it stays on a ship (aim it by turning): a standalone ship whose engine data comes from its model (docs/modding.md, "A ship from a model"). Meshes are CC0, built by tools/make_hunter.py; the beam sound is from Pixabay (sound/weapons/SOURCE.md).
